2607.06109.title: RoME: Robust Mixture of Low-Rank Experts against Multiple Adversarial Perturbations
2607.06109.paper_summary: Multi-perturbation adversarial training (MAT) aims to achieve robustness against multiple $\ell_p$ perturbations but suffers from robustness trade-offs between different threats. To address this, we employ a mixture of experts (MoE) to route different threats through distinct model pathways. However, naive application of MoE encounters two critical challenges: experts tend to overlook threat-specific features and redundantly capture features shared across threats, and gating networks suffer from threat-agnostic routing where they learn nearly identical routing patterns across threats, thus preventing the construction of threat-specific model pathways. To this end, we propose Robust Mixture of Low-Rank Experts (RoME), where each expert is a low-rank additive update to the shared backbone, allowing it to capture threat-common features while experts focus on threat-specific information. To address threat-agnostic routing, RoME introduces (i) dual-scale gating that exploits threat-discriminative signals from local and global level features, and (ii) threat-guided gating diversification that enforces diverse expert utilization across threats. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RoME outperforms existing state-of-the-art MAT in union robustness and natural accuracy and improves robustness against unseen threats. Codes are available at https://github.com/wkim97/RoME.
2607.06109.paper_summary_zh: 多擾動對抗訓練（MAT）旨在實現對多個 $\ell_p$ 擾動的魯棒性，但在不同威脅之間存在魯棒性權衡。為了解決這個問題，我們採用專家混合（MoE）來通過不同的模型路徑引導不同的威脅。然而，Naive 應用 MoE 會遇到兩個關鍵挑戰：專家往往忽視特定威脅的特徵，並且冗餘地捕捉跨威脅共享的特徵，而閘網絡則面臨與威脅無關的路由問題，導致它們在不同威脅之間學習幾乎相同的路由模式，從而阻礙了特定威脅模型路徑的構建。為此，我們提出了魯棒低秩專家混合（RoME），其中每個專家都是對共享主幹的低秩加性更新，使其能夠捕捉威脅共通特徵，同時專家專注於特定威脅的信息。為了解決與威脅無關的路由問題，RoME 引入了（i）雙尺度閘控，利用來自局部和全局層級特徵的威脅區分信號，以及（ii）威脅引導的閘控多樣化，強制在不同威脅之間多樣化專家的利用。大量實驗表明，RoME 在聯合魯棒性和自然準確性方面超越了現有的最先進的 MAT，並提高了對未見威脅的魯棒性。代碼可在 https://github.com/wkim97/RoME 獲得。
